sn35.154:1.1: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn35.154:1.2: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘equipped with faculties, equipped with faculties.’
sn35.154:1.3: In what way, venerable sir, is one equipped with faculties?”
sn35.154:2.1: “If, bhikkhu, while one dwells contemplating rise and fall in the eye faculty, one experiences revulsion towards the eye faculty;
sn35.154:2.2: if, while one dwells contemplating rise and fall in the ear faculty, one experiences revulsion towards the ear faculty; … if, while one dwells contemplating rise and fall in the mind faculty,
sn35.154:2.3: one experiences revulsion towards the mind faculty,
sn35.154:2.4: then, experiencing revulsion, one becomes dispassionate…. When the mind is liberated, there comes the knowledge: ‘It’s liberated.’
sn35.154:2.5: One understands: ‘Destroyed is birth, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is no more for this state of being.’
sn35.154:2.6: It is in this way, bhikkhu, that one is equipped with faculties.”
